svg.title: DataStory AI — AI data storytelling
svg.desc: Drop in a CSV, get a story: automated statistical analysis, an AI-written narrative and scrollytelling charts, exported as a polished PDF report. Built with Next.js, FastAPI, MongoDB, Gemini.
